title: 第6893章 修罗第6892章 青萍剑的贪婪
slug: 剑帝第6901章阴天子的悔意
lines: 青萍剑本就是孙冰的证道之器，理论上来说，伴随着他修为实力的提升，也能不断产生蜕变。
只可惜如此一来，蜕变的速度实在是太慢太慢了。
时至今日，即便这青萍剑乃是混沌灵宝，但却也有些跟不上孙冰了。
但想要让其进行终极一跃，成为混沌至宝，难度相当大。
毕竟每一件混沌级别的宝物，都蕴含着高维大道。
无尽岁月中，最多只出现过与混沌至宝比肩的奇观，真正从低晋升的混沌至宝，完全没有。
由此便能看出，这等宝物的晋升乃是何等困难，几乎可以说是不可能的事情。
可孙冰却并不想认命，而且如今在那修罗冥王剑上，他看到了最后的希望。
这一柄剑本就是混沌至宝。
一旦青萍剑将其吞噬，消化了其中的高维大道，自身定然能够有所蜕变。
此举看似简单粗暴，实际上却是很有可能实现的事情。
而另一边，听到了这一番话语的修罗鬼王，那丑陋的瞳孔中，都充满着血色光芒：
“好，好，好，纵然是阴天子都不敢这么对本王说话。
你区区一个人皇，竟然胆敢如此肆无忌惮。
那么让本王看看，你究竟有什么实力吧。”
话语落下的瞬间，修罗冥王剑直接朝着面前挥出。
“炼狱”
无尽的血色光芒汇集，这乃是修罗鬼王屠戮亿万兆生灵的杀气。
此时那些杀气化作了最为刺骨的锋刃，笼罩了亿万里疆域，似乎要将孙冰连带着时空，彻底覆灭。
感受到了这股力量，孙冰的瞳孔中都闪过一抹感慨。
不得不承认，浩瀚第五维度无边无垠，各种英雄人物如同过江之鲫。
虽然他已经算得上妖孽了，可能够与其比肩的存在，依旧不算少数。
例如面前的修罗鬼王，单单如今所爆发的力量，便不亚于曾经的神灵。
若是曾经的孙冰，与其交手完全就是痴人说梦。
只不过今非昔比，现在的他可不是什么弱者。
下一刻，青萍剑立刻挥出。
“凤凰展翅”
伴随着无尽的火光闪耀，翱翔的火凤立刻降临。
那灼热的力量焚烧天地，纵然是由杀气构建的血色锋刃，也随之被焚烧殆尽。
更甚至，那凤凰还在不断挥舞着羽翼，径直朝着修罗鬼王飞去。
如此变故让其面色微变，下一刻修罗冥王剑再次挥舞。
“修罗冥王斩”
这一刻，原本就弥漫天地的杀意再次爆发。
一切杀机化作了锐利的剑刃，不仅针对肉身，连带着心神都感受到了阵阵刺痛。
孙冰则没有退缩分毫，甚至与修罗鬼王交手，他都没有打算催动其余宝物。
整个人大步朝着面前跨出，青萍剑上同样绽放着淡淡的荧光。
顷刻间，两柄剑就已经发生了碰撞。
无论是孙冰还是修罗鬼王，其实都算是剑客。
只不过一者大气堂皇，每一次挥剑都蕴含着让人根本就无法反抗的威严。
而另一方，则另辟蹊径，以杀入道。
每一剑中蕴含的杀机，都比之先前要强上一分。
至于修罗鬼王自身，瞳孔中则闪烁着猩红的光芒。
伴随着自己身上的杀意提升，理智逐渐下降。
短短瞬息时间中，双方就已经厮杀了亿万招。
content_en:
The Qingping Sword is Sun Bing's tool for enlightenment. In theory, as his cultivation strength increases, it can continue to undergo transformation.
It's a pity that the speed of transformation is too slow.
To this day, even though the Qingping Sword is a Chaos Spiritual Treasure, it still cannot keep up with Sun Bing.
But it is quite difficult to make it make the ultimate leap and become the treasure of chaos.
After all, every chaos-level treasure contains high-dimensional avenues.
In the endless years, at most, there have only been spectacles comparable to the Chaos Arcana. There have been no Chaos Arcanas that have truly been promoted from a low level.
From this, we can see how difficult it is to promote such treasures, and it can almost be said to be impossible.
But Sun Bing didn't want to accept his fate, and now he saw the last hope on the Shura Pluto Sword.
This sword is originally the treasure of chaos.
Once the Qingping Sword swallows it and digests the high-dimensional avenue within it, it will definitely be able to transform.
This move seems simple and crude, but in fact it is very possible to achieve.
On the other side, after hearing these words, Shura Ghost King's ugly pupils were filled with bloody light:
"Okay, okay, okay, even Emperor Yin would not dare to speak to me like this.
You are just a human emperor, how dare you be so unscrupulous.
Then let me see what strength you have. "
The moment the words fell, the Shura Pluto Sword was swung directly in front of him.
"Purgatory"
The endless bloody light gathered together, this was the murderous intention of the Shura Ghost King to slaughter billions of living beings.
At this time, those murderous auras turned into the most piercing blades, covering hundreds of millions of miles of territory, seeming to completely destroy Sun Bing and the time and space.
Feeling this power, a flash of emotion flashed across Sun Bing's pupils.
I have to admit that the vast fifth dimension is boundless, and all kinds of heroes are like crucian carp crossing the river.
Although he can be considered a monster, there are still not a few beings who can compare with him.
For example, the power of the Shura Ghost King in front of him is no less than that of the gods in the past.
If it were the former Sun Bing, fighting against him would be a complete fantasy.
But things are different now, and he is not a weakling now.
The next moment, Qingping Sword was immediately swung out.
"Phoenix spreads its wings"
With endless firelight shining, the soaring fire phoenix descended immediately.
The scorching power burned the heaven and the earth, and even the blood-colored blade made of murderous intent was burned away.
What's more, the phoenix was still waving its wings and flying straight towards the Shura Ghost King.
Such a change caused his complexion to change slightly, and the next moment he waved the Shura Pluto Sword again.
"Shura Pluto Kill"
At this moment, the killing intent that originally filled the world broke out again.
All murderous intentions turned into sharp sword blades, not only targeting the physical body, but also feeling the stinging pain in the mind.
Sun Bing did not flinch at all. Even when he fought against Shura Ghost King, he had no intention of using the other treasures.
The whole person strode forward in front of him, and the Qingping sword also bloomed with a faint fluorescence.
In an instant, the two swords collided.
Both Sun Bing and Shura Ghost King are actually swordsmen.
It's just that one of them is majestic, and every time he swings his sword, there is a majesty that makes people unable to resist.
The other side, on the other hand, found another way to enter the Tao.
The murderous intention contained in each sword is stronger than the previous one.
As for the Shura Ghost King himself, his pupils were shining with scarlet light.
As the murderous intention in him increased, his sanity gradually declined.
In just a short period of time, the two sides had already fought with hundreds of millions of moves.
